xml_content: <TEI xmlns='http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0'><seg xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" type="excerpt" xml:id="ex14022025-03-31" status="finalized">dang po btags pa dgag pa ni <rs type="person" ana="corpusmd:unnamed_reference" ref="db:3816">kha 1</rs> <rs type="person" ana="corpusmd:named_reference" ref="db:3816">ar</rs> <lb edRef="inst:4574" n="131b5"/> mkhyen gsuM gyi rtogs pa gang rung skyed byed <abbr>mtshan nyid</abbr> du bkod pas kyang <abbr>sangs rgyas</abbr> skyed byed du mtshon nus so zhes gsung pa mi 'thad de <abbr>mtshan nyid</abbr> la ldog pa gsuM byung pas mtshon bya la'ang tha dad pas 1 skyed byed <abbr>mtshan nyid</abbr> du bzhag pan 2 po'i mtshon bya la ma khyab pa'i phyir dang nyan <lb edRef="inst:4574" n="131b6"/> rang gi sbyor ba la'ang gzhi shes kyi rtogs pa skyed byed yod pa'i phyir <abbr>sangs rgyas</abbr> skyed byed yod par thal lo ||</seg></TEI>
